candidate.title: Unbounded HTML colspan expands into excessive generated XML
candidate.originalEvidence: src/convert/altchunk.rs parses HTML td/th colspan directly to usize at 564-569; end_table sums spans at 469 then loops 0..cols at 489 to build one XML gridCol per numeric value. A tiny embedded HTML altChunk with colspan='1000000000' yields ~21GB WML before any later DOM limit, bypassing archive byte/XML depth budgets; reachable via altchunk::expand in converter.
